0022600197.text: The Lakers (8-2, first in the Pacific and third in the West) are on the road against the Detroit Pistons (6-2, first in the Central and third in the East), and LA is 3-1 away from home and has won four straight. Luka Doncic is out for the Lakers with back soreness, while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
